articles.title: Ether’s biggest corporate holders back new Ethereum research hub
articles.snippet: Ethlabs was formed with support from SharpLink, Bitmine and Consensys CEO Joe Lubin as the network's development is expanding beyond the Ethereum Foundation.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining network becoming more sensitive to price swings, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: A growing share of miners are operating near breakeven levels, making hashrate and mining difficulty increasingly responsive to bitcoin's price movements, the bank said.

articles.title: Bank of England backs down on strict stablecoin holding limits, sets $50 billion issuance cap
articles.snippet: The U.K. central bank abandons retail holding limits for a 40-billion-pound aggregate cap and sweetens yield terms for token issuers ahead of a 2027 market launch.

articles.title: Enso launches RWA app and trading for over 500 tokenized assets
articles.snippet: Enso launched access to over 500 tokenized assets and US stocks, citing a growing demand for US equity exposure among European investors.

articles.title: Japanese corporate pension fund plans 1% crypto allocation: Nikkei
articles.snippet: A Japanese corporate pension fund with about 1,200 participating small and medium-sized businesses plans to allocate roughly 1% of its assets to crypto.
